title: Cemeteries
summary: Since August 1996 individual cemeteries are established as corporate name headings (MARC 110) in the name authority file, not as geographic headings (151); headings still tagged 151 must be revised. Cemetery headings carry no BT from Cemeteries--[place] or National cemeteries--[place]. Works on individual cemeteries get the cemetery name plus headings such as [place]--Genealogy, Registers of births, etc.--[place], and Inscriptions--[place].
validation_rules: Individual cemeteries are corporate name headings (MARC 110 in the name authority file; 610 when assigned), e.g. `Ravenswood Cemetery (Jackson County, W. Va.)`, `Confederate Cemetery (Chattanooga, Tenn.)`; a cemetery heading coded as a geographic heading (151/651) reflects pre-August-1996 practice and must be revised. (H 1365 Background, sec. 1)
Cemetery headings have no broader term references from `Cemeteries--[place]` or `National cemeteries--[place]`. (H 1365 Background)
Assign the cemetery name heading only if it exists in RDA form tagged 110; otherwise establish or revise it. (H 1365 sec. 1)

Typical companion headings for works on individual cemeteries: `[place]--Genealogy`, `Registers of births, etc.--[place]`, `Inscriptions--[place]`, and for military burials `[war heading]--Registers of dead` and `[military body]--Registers of dead`. (H 1365 sec. 2)

sections.heading: 1. General rule
sections.text: If a heading for an individual cemetery exists in the name authority file in RDA form and is tagged 110, assign it as a subject heading. If the heading does not exist in the name authority file, or exists but is still tagged 151, establish a new name heading or revise the existing name heading (or refer the work to a descriptive cataloger to do so).

sections.heading: 2. Assignment of headings
sections.text:
To works on individual cemeteries, assign an array of headings, if appropriate, to bring out the most important aspects of the work. Examples:

```
Title: Ravenswood Cemetery : tombstone inscriptions.
610 20 $a Ravenswood Cemetery (Jackson County, W. Va.)
651 #0 $a Jackson County (W. Va.) $v Genealogy.
650 #0 $a Registers of births, etc. $z West Virginia
            $z Jackson County.
650 #0 $a Inscriptions $z West Virginia $z Jackson County.

Title: Our dead buried in the Chattanooga Confederate Cemetery.
651 #0 $a United States $x History $y Civil War, 1861-1865
            $v Registers of dead.
610 10 $a Confederate States of America. $b Army
            $v Registers of dead.
651 #0 $a Tennessee $v Genealogy.
651 #0 $a Chattanooga (Tenn.) $v Genealogy.
650 #0 $a Registers of births, etc. $z Tennessee
            $z Chattanooga.
610 20 $a Confederate Cemetery (Chattanooga, Tenn.)
```
